subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI Avatar not displaying (broken image)

question: Should Control UI support configured remote `http(s)` assistant avatars, or should remote avatar values be rejected/diagnosed for Control UI because the current CSP intentionally forbids remote image fetches?
rationale: Current source accepts remote avatar values but the documented Control UI security posture blocks remote browser image loads; choosing between diagnostics, proxying, or CSP relaxation requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep CSP and diagnose remote avatars
options.body: Preserve local/data/blob-only rendering and update CLI/config/docs/UI feedback so users know remote avatars do not render in Control UI.

options.title: Proxy remote avatars through Gateway
options.body: Support remote avatars only by fetching and bounding them server-side, then exposing same-origin or data/blob URLs to the browser.

options.title: Allow direct remote image loads
options.body: Relax `img-src` to let the browser fetch remote avatar URLs, accepting the weaker CSP and operator privacy tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Keep CSP and diagnose remote avatars
recommendation.body: Preserve local/data/blob-only rendering and update CLI/config/docs/UI feedback so users know remote avatars do not render in Control UI.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans original avatar support plus the authenticated-avatar/CSP rewrite that defines the current contract.
